cases.name: greeting
cases.answer: Hello Nishan, I'd be happy to help you prepare your project presentation. Can you please tell me a bit more about the project you're working on, such as the topic, industry, or the specific challenges you're facing? This will help me provide more tailored guidance.

cases.name: follow_up
cases.answer: I don't have any information about you or your project, Nishan. Our conversation just started, and I'm a large language model, I don't retain any information from previous conversations. I'm here to help with any questions or topics you'd like to discuss, though!

acceptance_note: Follow-up requires both the supplied name and project, without denying conversation context.
